title: Fundamentals of Astrophysics: A Working Guide
summary: A 4-week practical course on understanding celestial mechanics, stellar evolution, and cosmic scales using accessible physics.

days.title: Cosmic Distances
objectives: Calculate light-years to parsecs
Explain the inverse-square law for brightness

days.title: The Electromagnetic Spectrum in Space
objectives: Identify which wavebands penetrate Earth's atmosphere
Relate photon wavelength to energy

days.title: Blackbody Radiation
objectives: Apply Wien's Law to find a star's temperature
Calculate peak wavelength from temperature

days.title: Stefan-Boltzmann Law
objectives: Calculate star luminosity from radius and temperature
Explain surface flux differences

days.title: Stellar Spectroscopy
objectives: Interpret absorption lines in stellar spectra
Identify spectral classes O through M

days.title: Hydrostatic Equilibrium
objectives: Balance gravity and pressure in a simple stellar model
Explain why stars do not collapse instantly

days.title: Nuclear Fusion in Cores
objectives: Describe the proton-proton chain
Calculate mass-energy conversion using Einstein's equation

days.title: The Hertzsprung-Russell Diagram
objectives: Plot stars on an HR diagram
Identify main sequence, giants, and white dwarfs

days.title: Low-Mass Star Evolution
objectives: Trace the path of a Sun-like star off the main sequence
Describe planetary nebula formation

days.title: High-Mass Stars and Supernovae
objectives: Describe core collapse in massive stars
Differentiate Type Ia and Type II supernovae

days.title: White Dwarfs and Degeneracy
objectives: Explain electron degeneracy pressure
State the Chandrasekhar limit

days.title: Neutron Stars and Pulsars
objectives: Describe neutron star formation
Explain the lighthouse model of pulsars

days.title: Introduction to Black Holes
objectives: Calculate the Schwarzschild radius for a given mass
Define the event horizon

days.title: Orbital Mechanics Basics
objectives: Apply Kepler's Third Law to binary systems
Calculate orbital periods from masses and separation

days.title: Binary Star Systems
objectives: Determine masses using spectroscopic binaries
Identify Roche lobes and mass transfer

days.title: Milky Way Structure
objectives: Identify galactic disk, bulge, and halo components
Describe stellar population differences

days.title: Galaxy Classification
objectives: Classify galaxies using the Hubble tuning fork
Distinguish spirals from ellipticals

days.title: Dark Matter Evidence
objectives: Interpret galaxy rotation curves
Explain the necessity of dark matter

days.title: Cosmic Expansion
objectives: Calculate recession velocity using Hubble's Law
Interpret cosmological redshift

days.title: The Early Universe
objectives: Describe the Cosmic Microwave Background
Summarize standard Big Bang timeline milestones
